function validDraftPatch(value: unknown): value is JsonRecord {
  if (!isRecord(value) || !hasExactKeys(value, ["contractVersion", "baseDraftVersion", "atomic", "patches"]) || value.contractVersion !== "0.1.0" || !Number.isInteger(value.baseDraftVersion) || Number(value.baseDraftVersion) < 0 || value.atomic !== true || !Array.isArray(value.patches) || value.patches.length < 1 || value.patches.length > 16) return false;
  return value.patches.every((patch) => isRecord(patch) && hasExactKeys(patch, ["op", "target", "precondition", "evidenceSpan", "reasonCode"], ["value"]) && new Set(["add", "replace", "remove", "set"]).has(String(patch.op)) && isRecord(patch.evidenceSpan) && hasExactKeys(patch.evidenceSpan, ["text", "start", "end", "offsetUnit"]) && typeof patch.evidenceSpan.text === "string" && patch.evidenceSpan.text.length >= 1 && patch.evidenceSpan.text.length <= 500 && Number.isInteger(patch.evidenceSpan.start) && Number(patch.evidenceSpan.start) >= 0 && Number.isInteger(patch.evidenceSpan.end) && Number(patch.evidenceSpan.end) >= 1 && Number(patch.evidenceSpan.end) > Number(patch.evidenceSpan.start) && patch.evidenceSpan.offsetUnit === "unicode_code_point" && new Set(["user_addition", "user_correction", "user_removal"]).has(String(patch.reasonCode)) && validPatchVariant(patch));
}
type EnumCueCategory = "exit" | "comparison" | "cross" | "logical" | "feature_source";
const ENUM_CUES: Readonly<Record<EnumCueCategory, Readonly<Record<string, readonly RegExp[]>>>> = {
  exit: { stop_loss: [/손절/u, /\bstop(?:[-_ ]?loss)\b/u], take_profit: [/익절/u, /\btake(?:[-_ ]?profit)\b/u] },
  comparison: {
    lt: [/(?<!<)<(?!=)/u, /미만/u, /보다\s*작/u, /\bless\s+than\b(?!\s+or\s+equal)/u, /\b(?:below|under)\b/u],
    lte: [/<=|≤/u, /이하/u, /\b(?:at\s+most|less\s+than\s+or\s+equal(?:\s+to)?)\b/u],
    gt: [/(?<!>)>(?!=)/u, /초과/u, /보다\s*크/u, /\bgreater\s+than\b(?!\s+or\s+equal)/u, /\b(?:above|over)\b/u],
    gte: [/>=|≥/u, /이상/u, /\b(?:at\s+least|greater\s+than\s+or\s+equal(?:\s+to)?)\b/u],
  },
  cross: {
    cross_above: [/상향\s*돌파/u, /골든\s*크로스/u, /\bcross(?:es|ed|ing)?(?:[_ -]+)above\b/u],
    cross_below: [/하향\s*돌파/u, /데드\s*크로스/u, /\bcross(?:es|ed|ing)?(?:[_ -]+)below\b/u],
  },
  logical: { and: [/그리고/u, /동시에/u, /&&/u, /\band\b/u], or: [/또는/u, /혹은/u, /\|\|/u, /\bor\b/u] },
  feature_source: { high: [/고가/u, /\bhigh\b/u], low: [/저가/u, /\blow\b/u], close: [/종가/u, /\bclos(?:e|ing)\b/u], volume: [/거래량/u, /\bvolume\b/u] },
};
function detectedEnumCues(evidence: string, category: EnumCueCategory): Set<string> {
  const normalized = evidence.normalize("NFC").toLocaleLowerCase("en-US");
  return new Set(Object.entries(ENUM_CUES[category]).filter(([, patterns]) => patterns.some((pattern) => pattern.test(normalized))).map(([value]) => value));
}
function conditionOperators(condition: JsonRecord): string[] {
  const operators = typeof condition.operator === "string" ? [condition.operator] : [];
  if (condition.kind === "logical" && Array.isArray(condition.conditions)) for (const child of condition.conditions) if (isRecord(child)) operators.push(...conditionOperators(child));
  return operators;
}
function sameStringSet(left: Set<string>, right: Set<string>): boolean { return left.size === right.size && [...left].every((value) => right.has(value)); }
function assertDraftPatchEnumGrounding(draftPatch: JsonRecord): void {
  if (!Array.isArray(draftPatch.patches)) return;
  for (const patch of draftPatch.patches) {
    if (!isRecord(patch) || !isRecord(patch.target) || !isRecord(patch.value) || !isRecord(patch.evidenceSpan) || typeof patch.evidenceSpan.text !== "string") continue;
    const expected = new Map<EnumCueCategory, Set<string>>();
    if (patch.target.entity === "exit_rule" && patch.op === "set" && typeof patch.value.kind === "string") expected.set("exit", new Set([patch.value.kind]));
    if (patch.target.entity === "feature" && patch.op === "add" && typeof patch.value.source === "string") expected.set("feature_source", new Set([patch.value.source]));
    if (patch.target.entity === "entry_rule" && patch.op === "add" && isRecord(patch.value.condition)) {
      const operators = new Set(conditionOperators(patch.value.condition));
      for (const category of ["comparison", "cross", "logical"] as const) { const values = new Set([...operators].filter((value) => value in ENUM_CUES[category])); if (values.size) expected.set(category, values); }
    }
    for (const [category, values] of expected) if (!sameStringSet(values, detectedEnumCues(patch.evidenceSpan.text, category))) throw new Error("INVALID_PATCH_ENUM_GROUNDING");
  }
}
function validCompilerTurnResult(value: unknown): value is JsonRecord {
  if (!isRecord(value) || value.contractVersion !== "0.1.0" || !validCompilerSource(value.source)) return false;
  if (value.status === "PATCH_PROPOSED") return hasExactKeys(value, ["contractVersion", "status", "source", "draftPatch"]) && validDraftPatch(value.draftPatch);
  if (value.status === "CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED") return hasExactKeys(value, ["contractVersion", "status", "source", "question"]) && validCompilerQuestion(value.question);
  return value.status === "UNSUPPORTED" && hasExactKeys(value, ["contractVersion", "status", "source", "reasonCode", "message"]) && new Set(["UNREGISTERED_INDICATOR", "SUBJECTIVE_SIGNAL", "ARBITRARY_CODE", "OUT_OF_SCOPE_CAPABILITY", "RISK_POLICY_CONFLICT"]).has(String(value.reasonCode)) && typeof value.message === "string" && value.message.length >= 1 && value.message.length <= 500;
}
function validDraftState(value: unknown): value is JsonRecord { return isRecord(value) && hasExactKeys(value, ["contractVersion", "draftId", "revision", "serverDefaultsVersion", "projection", "projectionHash"]) && value.contractVersion === "0.2.0" && matches(value.draftId, DRAFT_ID) && Number.isInteger(value.revision) && Number(value.revision) >= 0 && value.serverDefaultsVersion === "draft-defaults-0.2.0" && validDraftProjection(value.projection) && matches(value.projectionHash, SHA256); }
function validMergeIssue(value: unknown): boolean { return isRecord(value) && hasExactKeys(value, ["code", "instancePath"], ["patchIndex"]) && /^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{2,80}$/.test(String(value.code)) && typeof value.instancePath === "string" && value.instancePath.startsWith("/") && (value.patchIndex === undefined || (Number.isInteger(value.patchIndex) && Number(value.patchIndex) >= 0 && Number(value.patchIndex) <= 15)); }
function validMergeResult(value: unknown): value is JsonRecord {
  if (!isRecord(value) || !hasExactKeys(value, ["contractVersion", "status", "sourceTurnId", "baseDraftRevision", "resultDraftRevision", "beforeProjectionHash", "afterProjectionHash", "appliedPatchCount", "draftState", "issues"]) || value.contractVersion !== "0.2.0" || !new Set(["APPLIED", "REJECTED"]).has(String(value.status)) || typeof value.sourceTurnId !== "string" || value.sourceTurnId.length < 1 || value.sourceTurnId.length > 128 || !Number.isInteger(value.baseDraftRevision) || Number(value.baseDraftRevision) < 0 || !Number.isInteger(value.resultDraftRevision) || Number(value.resultDraftRevision) < 0 || !matches(value.beforeProjectionHash, SHA256) || !matches(value.afterProjectionHash, SHA256) || !Number.isInteger(value.appliedPatchCount) || Number(value.appliedPatchCount) < 0 || Number(value.appliedPatchCount) > 16 || !validDraftState(value.draftState) || !Array.isArray(value.issues) || value.issues.length > 32 || !value.issues.every(validMergeIssue)) return false;
  return value.status === "APPLIED" ? Number(value.appliedPatchCount) >= 1 && value.issues.length === 0 : Number(value.appliedPatchCount) === 0 && value.issues.length >= 1;
}
function validConversationTurnData(data: JsonRecord): boolean {
  const compiler = data.compilerTurnResult; const draftState = data.draftState;
  if (!(matches(data.conversationId, CONVERSATION_ID) && matches(data.turnId, TURN_ID) && matches(data.draftId, DRAFT_ID) && validRevision(data.draftRevision) && validCompilerTurnResult(compiler) && validDraftState(draftState) && new Set(["INCOMPLETE", "READY_FOR_VALIDATION"]).has(String(data.candidateState)) && matches(data.projectionHash, SHA256))) return false;
  const source = compiler.source;
  if (!validCompilerSource(source) || draftState.draftId !== data.draftId || String(draftState.revision) !== data.draftRevision || draftState.projectionHash !== data.projectionHash || source.turnId !== data.turnId) return false;
  const merge = data.mergeResult; const ready = data.candidateState === "READY_FOR_VALIDATION";
  if (compiler.status !== "PATCH_PROPOSED") {
    if (merge !== null || ready || data.semanticHash !== null || !validNextQuestion(data.nextQuestion)) return false;
    if (compiler.status === "CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED") return canonicalJson(compiler.question) === canonicalJson(data.nextQuestion);
    return isRecord(data.nextQuestion) && data.nextQuestion.kind === "UNSUPPORTED_CLAUSE" && data.nextQuestion.reasonCode === compiler.reasonCode;
  }
  const draftPatch = compiler.draftPatch;
  if (!validDraftPatch(draftPatch) || !validMergeResult(merge) || merge.sourceTurnId !== data.turnId || merge.baseDraftRevision !== draftPatch.baseDraftVersion || merge.resultDraftRevision !== draftState.revision || merge.afterProjectionHash !== data.projectionHash || canonicalJson(merge.draftState) !== canonicalJson(draftState)) return false;
  if (merge.status === "APPLIED" && Number(merge.resultDraftRevision) !== Number(merge.baseDraftRevision) + 1) return false;
  if (merge.status === "APPLIED" && Array.isArray(draftPatch.patches) && merge.appliedPatchCount !== draftPatch.patches.length) return false;
  if (merge.status === "REJECTED") return !ready && data.semanticHash === null && validNextQuestion(data.nextQuestion);
  if (ready) return matches(data.semanticHash, SHA256) && data.nextQuestion === null && validStrategyAstProjection(draftState.projection);
  return data.semanticHash === null && isRecord(data.nextQuestion) && data.nextQuestion.kind === "CANDIDATE_MISSING_PATH" && validNextQuestion(data.nextQuestion);
}
function validBacktestJobData(data: JsonRecord): boolean {
  const base = matches(data.backtestId, BACKTEST_ID) && matches(data.splitGroupId, SPLIT_ID) && matches(data.strategyVersionId, STRATEGY_VERSION_ID) && matches(data.semanticHash, SHA256) && new Set(["STRUCTURAL_SMOKE", "INTERNAL_POC_FULL"]).has(String(data.profileId)) && matches(data.profileContentHash, SHA256) && EVENT_STATES.has(String(data.state)) && validRevision(data.revision) && validTimestamp(data.createdAt) && validTimestamp(data.updatedAt) && validSourceProvenance(data.sourceProvenance) && typeof data.resultAvailable === "boolean";
  if (!base) return false;
  if (data.state === "COMPLETED") return data.resultAvailable === true && matches(data.resultContentHash, SHA256) && matches(data.runContentHash, SHA256) && data.invalidReason === undefined;
  if (data.state === "INVALID") return data.resultAvailable === false && new Set(["DATA_CONTRACT_INVALID", "STRATEGY_CONTRACT_INVALID", "ASSUMPTION_CONTRACT_INVALID", "RUNTIME_RESULT_INVALID", "VERIFICATION_FAILED"]).has(String(data.invalidReason)) && data.resultContentHash === undefined && data.runContentHash === undefined;
  return data.resultAvailable === false && data.resultContentHash === undefined && data.runContentHash === undefined && data.invalidReason === undefined;
}
function assertDeepOperationData(operationId: OperationId, data: JsonRecord): void {
  const sessionOperations = new Set<OperationId>(["createAnonymousSession", "getAuthSession", "logout"]);
  if (sessionOperations.has(operationId) && !(matches(data.sessionId, SESSION_ID) && new Set(["ANONYMOUS", "AUTHENTICATED", "REVOKED"]).has(String(data.state)) && validRevision(data.revision) && validTimestamp(data.issuedAt) && validTimestamp(data.expiresAt))) throw new Error("INVALID_OPERATION_RESPONSE_SCHEMA");
  if (operationId === "getCsrfToken" && !(typeof data.csrfToken === "string" && data.csrfToken.length >= 16 && data.csrfToken.length <= 256 && validTimestamp(data.expiresAt))) throw new Error("INVALID_OPERATION_RESPONSE_SCHEMA");
  if (operationId === "startGoogleOAuth" && !(typeof data.authorizationRedirect === "string" && /^https:\/\/accounts\.google\.com\/o\/oauth2\/v2\/auth\?[A-Za-z0-9._~!$&'()*+,;=:@%/?-]+$/.test(data.authorizationRedirect))) throw new Error("INVALID_OPERATION_RESPONSE_SCHEMA");
  if (operationId === "getOAuthResult" && !new Set(["PENDING", "AUTHENTICATED", "FAILED"]).has(String(data.status))) throw new Error("INVALID_OPERATION_RESPONSE_SCHEMA");
  if (operationId === "getMe" && !(typeof data.authenticated === "boolean" && (data.principalDisplay === undefined || (typeof data.principalDisplay === "string" && data.principalDisplay.length >= 1 && data.principalDisplay.length <= 80)) && (data.authenticated || data.principalDisplay === undefined))) throw new Error("INVALID_OPERATION_RESPONSE_SCHEMA");
  if (operationId === "claimAnonymousSession" && !(matches(data.sessionId, SESSION_ID) && data.state === "AUTHENTICATED" && validRevision(data.revision) && isRecord(data.claimedResourceCounts) && hasExactKeys(data.claimedResourceCounts, ["conversations", "messages", "drafts", "patches", "validations", "idempotencyRecords"]) && Object.values(data.claimedResourceCounts).every((value) => Number.isInteger(value) && Number(value) >= 0) && data.oldSessionRevoked === true)) throw new Error("INVALID_OPERATION_RESPONSE_SCHEMA");
  if (operationId === "createConversation" && !(matches(data.conversationId, CONVERSATION_ID) && matches(data.draftId, DRAFT_ID) && validRevision(data.draftRevision))) throw new Error("INVALID_OPERATION_RESPONSE_SCHEMA");
  if (operationId === "createConversationTurn" && !validConversationTurnData(data)) throw new Error("INVALID_OPERATION_RESPONSE_SCHEMA");
  if ((operationId === "getStrategyDraft" || operationId === "patchStrategyDraft") && !validDraftState(data)) throw new Error("INVALID_OPERATION_RESPONSE_SCHEMA");
  if (operationId === "validateStrategyDraft") {
    const issues = data.issues;
    const base = matches(data.draftId, DRAFT_ID) && validRevision(data.draftRevision) && matches(data.projectionHash, SHA256) && Array.isArray(issues) && typeof data.defaultsVersion === "string" && validPin(data.registryPin) && validPin(data.evaluatorPin) && validPin(data.riskPolicyPin) && validPin(data.contractsPin);
    const valid = data.status === "VALID" && Array.isArray(issues) && issues.length === 0 && matches(data.validationReceiptId, VALIDATION_RECEIPT_ID) && matches(data.semanticHash, SHA256) && validTimestamp(data.issuedAt) && validTimestamp(data.expiresAt) && data.consumptionState === "AVAILABLE";
    const invalid = data.status === "INVALID" && Array.isArray(issues) && issues.length >= 1 && data.validationReceiptId === undefined && data.semanticHash === undefined && data.issuedAt === undefined && data.expiresAt === undefined && data.consumptionState === undefined;
    if (!(base && (valid || invalid))) throw new Error("INVALID_OPERATION_RESPONSE_SCHEMA");
  }
  if (operationId === "createApprovalChallenge" && !(matches(data.approvalChallengeId, APPROVAL_CHALLENGE_ID) && matches(data.draftId, DRAFT_ID) && validRevision(data.draftRevision) && matches(data.validationReceiptId, VALIDATION_RECEIPT_ID) && matches(data.semanticHash, SHA256) && validTimestamp(data.issuedAt) && validTimestamp(data.expiresAt) && data.consumptionState === "AVAILABLE")) throw new Error("INVALID_OPERATION_RESPONSE_SCHEMA");
  if (operationId === "approveStrategyDraft" && !(matches(data.strategyVersionId, STRATEGY_VERSION_ID) && matches(data.strategyVersionContentHash, SHA256) && matches(data.sourceDraftId, DRAFT_ID) && validRevision(data.sourceDraftRevision) && matches(data.sourceProjectionHash, SHA256) && matches(data.semanticHash, SHA256) && matches(data.validationReceiptId, VALIDATION_RECEIPT_ID) && matches(data.approvalChallengeId, APPROVAL_CHALLENGE_ID) && matches(data.issuanceReceiptId, ISSUANCE_RECEIPT_ID) && validTimestamp(data.issuedAt))) throw new Error("INVALID_OPERATION_RESPONSE_SCHEMA");
  if (["submitBacktest", "getBacktest", "cancelBacktest"].includes(operationId) && !validBacktestJobData(data)) throw new Error("INVALID_OPERATION_RESPONSE_SCHEMA");
  if (operationId === "getVerifiedBacktestReport") {
    if (!(matches(data.backtestId, BACKTEST_ID) && matches(data.splitGroupId, SPLIT_ID) && matches(data.strategyVersionId, STRATEGY_VERSION_ID) && matches(data.semanticHash, SHA256) && new Set(["STRUCTURAL_SMOKE", "INTERNAL_POC_FULL"]).has(String(data.profileId)) && matches(data.profileContentHash, SHA256) && matches(data.dataManifestContentHash, SHA256) && matches(data.assumptionManifestContentHash, SHA256) && validPin(data.enginePin) && Array.isArray(data.segments) && data.segments.length === 2 && data.segments.every((segment, index) => isRecord(segment) && segment.segment === ["IS", "OOS"][index] && validRuntimeProjection(segment.runtimeResult) && matches(segment.tradeManifestContentHash, SHA256)) && validSourceProvenance(data.sourceProvenance) && matches(data.reportContentHash, SHA256))) throw new Error("INVALID_OPERATION_RESPONSE_SCHEMA");
  }
  if (operationId === "getTradeManifest" && !(matches(data.backtestId, BACKTEST_ID) && matches(data.splitGroupId, SPLIT_ID) && Array.isArray(data.segments) && data.segments.length === 2 && data.segments.every((segment, index) => isRecord(segment) && segment.segment === ["IS", "OOS"][index] && matches(segment.resultContentHash, SHA256) && Number.isInteger(segment.tradeCount) && Number(segment.tradeCount) >= 0 && matches(segment.tradeManifestContentHash, SHA256)) && validSourceProvenance(data.sourceProvenance))) throw new Error("INVALID_OPERATION_RESPONSE_SCHEMA");
  if (operationId === "listBacktestTrades" && !(matches(data.backtestId, BACKTEST_ID) && new Set(["IS", "OOS"]).has(String(data.segment)) && matches(data.resultContentHash, SHA256) && matches(data.tradeManifestContentHash, SHA256) && Number.isInteger(data.limit) && Number(data.limit) >= 1 && Number(data.limit) <= 100 && Array.isArray(data.trades) && data.trades.length <= 100 && data.trades.every(validTrade) && validSourceProvenance(data.sourceProvenance) && (data.nextCursor === undefined || (typeof data.nextCursor === "string" && data.nextCursor.length >= 24 && data.nextCursor.length <= 512)))) throw new Error("INVALID_OPERATION_RESPONSE_SCHEMA");
}
async function assertOperationSuccess(operationId: OperationId, value: unknown, responseType: string, security: ClientSecurityOptions, input: unknown): Promise<void> {
  if (responseType === "null") { if (value !== null) throw new Error("INVALID_NULL_RESPONSE"); return; }
  assertApiSuccessEnvelope(value);
  const envelope = value as { readonly data: JsonRecord };
  const shape = RESPONSE_DATA_SHAPES[operationId];
  if (!shape || !hasExactKeys(envelope.data, shape.required, shape.optional ?? [])) throw new Error("INVALID_OPERATION_RESPONSE_SCHEMA");
  assertDeepOperationData(operationId, envelope.data);
  if (operationId === "createConversationTurn") {
    if (!isRecord(input) || !isRecord(input.body) || typeof input.body.message !== "string" || !isRecord(envelope.data.compilerTurnResult)) throw new Error("INVALID_CONVERSATION_TURN_EXCHANGE");
    await assertCompilerGrounding(envelope.data.compilerTurnResult, input.body.message);
    const compilerPatch = envelope.data.compilerTurnResult.draftPatch;
    if (isRecord(compilerPatch) && String(compilerPatch.baseDraftVersion) !== input.body.expectedDraftRevision) throw new Error("INVALID_COMPILER_BASE_REVISION");
  }
  if (new Set<OperationId>(["submitBacktest", "getBacktest", "cancelBacktest", "getVerifiedBacktestReport", "getTradeManifest", "listBacktestTrades"]).has(operationId)) await assertPrivateSourceProvenanceAuthority(envelope.data.sourceProvenance, security);
  if (new Set<OperationId>(["submitBacktest", "getBacktest", "cancelBacktest", "getVerifiedBacktestReport"]).has(operationId)) {
    const profile = security.trustedBacktestProfileAuthority;
    if (!profile || envelope.data.profileId !== profile.profileId || envelope.data.profileContentHash !== profile.profileContentHash) throw new Error("UNTRUSTED_BACKTEST_PROFILE_AUTHORITY");
  }
  if (operationId === "listBacktestTrades") {
    const binding = envelope.data.cursorBinding;
    if (!isRecord(binding) || !hasExactKeys(binding, ["backtestId", "segment", "resultContentHash", "tradeManifestContentHash"]) || ["backtestId", "segment", "resultContentHash", "tradeManifestContentHash"].some((field) => binding[field] !== envelope.data[field])) throw new Error("INVALID_TRADE_PAGE_BINDING");
  }
  if (operationId === "getVerifiedBacktestReport") {
    const receipt = envelope.data.verifierReceipt;
    if (!isRecord(receipt) || !hasExactKeys(receipt, ["receiptId", "subjectContentHash", "contentHash", "contractsPin", "verifierPin", "trustAnchorContentHash"])) throw new Error("INVALID_VERIFIER_RECEIPT_SCHEMA");
    const trusted = security.trustedVerifierAuthority;
    if (!trusted || canonicalJson(receipt.verifierPin) !== canonicalJson(trusted.verifierPin) || receipt.trustAnchorContentHash !== trusted.trustAnchorContentHash || receipt.contentHash !== trusted.expectedReceiptContentHash || receipt.subjectContentHash !== trusted.expectedSubjectContentHash) throw new Error("UNTRUSTED_VERIFIER_AUTHORITY");
    const { contentHash: receiptHash, ...receiptProjection } = receipt;
    const expectedReceiptHash = await sha256Hex(`tesia.api.verifier-receipt.v0.1.0\0${canonicalJson(receiptProjection)}`);
    const { reportContentHash, verifierReceipt: _receipt, ...reportProjection } = envelope.data;
    if (isRecord(reportProjection.sourceProvenance) && "verifierReceipt" in reportProjection.sourceProvenance) { const { verifierReceipt: _nestedReceipt, ...provenance } = reportProjection.sourceProvenance; reportProjection.sourceProvenance = provenance; }
    const expectedReportHash = await sha256Hex(`tesia.api.verified-report.v0.1.0\0${canonicalJson(reportProjection)}`);
    if (receiptHash !== expectedReceiptHash || reportContentHash !== expectedReportHash || receipt.subjectContentHash !== reportContentHash) throw new Error("INVALID_VERIFIED_REPORT_HASH_CHAIN");
    if (isRecord(envelope.data.sourceProvenance) && envelope.data.sourceProvenance.source === "PRIVATE_ACTUAL_REPLAY" && canonicalJson(envelope.data.sourceProvenance.verifierReceipt) !== canonicalJson(receipt)) throw new Error("INVALID_NESTED_VERIFIER_RECEIPT_BINDING");
  }
}
async function assertPrivateSourceProvenanceAuthority(value: unknown, security: ClientSecurityOptions): Promise<void> {
  if (!isRecord(value) || value.source !== "PRIVATE_ACTUAL_REPLAY") return;
  const receipt = value.verifierReceipt;
  const trusted = security.trustedVerifierAuthority;
  if (!validVerifierReceipt(receipt) || !trusted || canonicalJson(receipt.verifierPin) !== canonicalJson(trusted.verifierPin) || receipt.trustAnchorContentHash !== trusted.trustAnchorContentHash || receipt.contentHash !== trusted.expectedReceiptContentHash || receipt.subjectContentHash !== trusted.expectedSubjectContentHash) throw new Error("UNTRUSTED_SOURCE_PROVENANCE_AUTHORITY");
  const { contentHash, ...projection } = receipt;
  const expected = await sha256Hex(`tesia.api.verifier-receipt.v0.1.0\0${canonicalJson(projection)}`);
  if (contentHash !== expected) throw new Error("INVALID_SOURCE_PROVENANCE_RECEIPT_HASH");
}
function isErrorEnvelope(value: unknown): value is ErrorEnvelope {
  if (!isRecord(value) || !hasExactKeys(value, ["meta", "error"]) || !isRecord(value.error) || !hasExactKeys(value.error, ["code", "message"], ["field"])) return false;
  try { assertResponseMeta(value.meta); } catch { return false; }
  return typeof value.error.code === "string" && API_ERROR_CODES.has(value.error.code) && typeof value.error.message === "string" && value.error.message.length <= 240 && (value.error.field === undefined || typeof value.error.field === "string");
}
function validatedApiResponseError(operation: ManifestOperation, status: number, body: unknown): ApiResponseError {
  if (!isErrorEnvelope(body)) throw new Error("INVALID_ERROR_ENVELOPE");
  const statusByCode = operation.errorStatusByCode as Readonly<Record<string, number>>;
  if (statusByCode[body.error.code] !== status) throw new Error("INVALID_ERROR_STATUS_POLICY");
  return new ApiResponseError(status, body);
}
function canonicalJson(value: unknown): string {
  if (value === null || typeof value === "boolean" || typeof value === "string") return JSON.stringify(value);
  if (typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value)) return JSON.stringify(value);
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return `[${value.map(canonicalJson).join(",")}]`;
  if (isRecord(value)) return `{${Object.keys(value).sort().map((key) => `${JSON.stringify(key)}:${canonicalJson(value[key])}`).join(",")}}`;
  throw new Error("NON_CANONICAL_JSON_VALUE");
}
async function sha256Hex(value: string): Promise<string> {
  const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", new TextEncoder().encode(value));
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest), (byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
}
function patchTargetKey(value: unknown): readonly string[] | undefined {
  if (!isRecord(value) || typeof value.entity !== "string") return undefined;
  if (value.entity === "condition") return ["entry_rule", String(value.entryRuleId), "condition", String(value.conditionId), String(value.field)];
  if (typeof value.id === "string") return [value.entity, value.id, ...(typeof value.field === "string" ? [value.field] : [])];
  return [value.entity, ...(typeof value.field === "string" ? [value.field] : [])];
}
async function assertCompilerGrounding(compiler: JsonRecord, sourceText: string): Promise<void> {
  const source = compiler.source;
  if (!validCompilerSource(source)) throw new Error("INVALID_COMPILER_SOURCE");
  const normalized = sourceText.normalize("NFC");
  if (source.textSha256 !== await sha256Hex(normalized)) throw new Error("INVALID_COMPILER_SOURCE_HASH");
  if (compiler.status !== "PATCH_PROPOSED") return;
  const draftPatch = compiler.draftPatch;
  if (!validDraftPatch(draftPatch) || !Array.isArray(draftPatch.patches)) throw new Error("INVALID_DRAFT_PATCH");
  assertDraftPatchEnumGrounding(draftPatch);
  const codePoints = Array.from(normalized); const keys: string[][] = [];
  for (const patchValue of draftPatch.patches) {
    if (!isRecord(patchValue) || !isRecord(patchValue.evidenceSpan)) throw new Error("INVALID_DRAFT_PATCH");
    const span = patchValue.evidenceSpan; const start = Number(span.start); const end = Number(span.end);
    if (typeof span.text !== "string" || span.text !== span.text.normalize("NFC") || end <= start || end > codePoints.length || codePoints.slice(start, end).join("") !== span.text) throw new Error("INVALID_COMPILER_GROUNDING_SPAN");
    const key = patchTargetKey(patchValue.target); if (!key) throw new Error("INVALID_PATCH_TARGET");
    if (keys.some((existing) => canonicalJson(existing) === canonicalJson(key) || (existing.length < key.length && existing.every((part, index) => key[index] === part)) || (key.length < existing.length && key.every((part, index) => existing[index] === part)))) throw new Error("DUPLICATE_OR_OVERLAPPING_PATCH_TARGET");
    keys.push([...key]);
  }
}
async function assertOperationInput(operationId: OperationId, input: unknown): Promise<void> {
  if (!isRecord(input) || !isRecord(input.body)) return;
  if (operationId === "patchStrategyDraft") {
    const body = input.body;
    if (!validRevision(body.expectedDraftRevision) || !validCompilerSource(body.source) || !validDraftPatch(body.draftPatch) || !isRecord(body.draftPatch) || String(body.draftPatch.baseDraftVersion) !== body.expectedDraftRevision) throw new Error("INVALID_DRAFT_PATCH_REQUEST");
    assertDraftPatchEnumGrounding(body.draftPatch);
  }
}
function legalTransition(previous: string, current: string): boolean {
  return NORMAL_TRANSITIONS.has(`${previous}>${current}`) || (EXECUTION_STATES.has(previous) && new Set(["CANCEL_REQUESTED", "INVALID", "FAILED"]).has(current));
}
async function parseBacktestEventFrame(frame: string): Promise<BacktestEvent> {
  const matched = /^id: ([^\n]+)\nevent: backtest\.state\ndata: ([^\n]+)\n\n$/.exec(frame);
  if (!matched?.[1] || !matched[2]) throw new Error("INVALID_SSE_FRAME");
  let parsed: unknown; try { parsed = JSON.parse(matched[2]); } catch { throw new Error("INVALID_SSE_JSON"); }
  const keys = ["apiContractVersion", "backtestId", "sequence", "jobRevision", "previousState", "state", "occurredAt", "contentHash"];
  if (!isRecord(parsed) || !hasExactKeys(parsed, keys) || parsed.apiContractVersion !== API_CONTRACT_VERSION || !BACKTEST_ID.test(String(parsed.backtestId)) || !validRevision(parsed.sequence) || !validRevision(parsed.jobRevision) || matched[1] !== parsed.sequence || !EVENT_STATES.has(String(parsed.state)) || (parsed.previousState !== null && !EVENT_STATES.has(String(parsed.previousState))) || !validTimestamp(parsed.occurredAt) || typeof parsed.contentHash !== "string" || !SHA256.test(parsed.contentHash)) throw new Error("INVALID_SSE_EVENT_SCHEMA");
  if ((parsed.previousState === null && parsed.state !== "QUEUED") || (typeof parsed.previousState === "string" && !legalTransition(parsed.previousState, String(parsed.state)))) throw new Error("INVALID_SSE_STATE_TRANSITION");
  const payload = { ...parsed }; delete payload.contentHash;
  const expectedHash = await sha256Hex(`tesia.api.backtest-event.v0.1.0\n${canonicalJson(payload)}`);
  if (expectedHash !== parsed.contentHash) throw new Error("INVALID_SSE_CONTENT_HASH");
  return parsed as unknown as BacktestEvent;
}
export class SseResyncRequiredError extends Error { constructor() { super("SSE_CLOSE_AND_GET_SNAPSHOT_RESYNC"); } }

export class TesiaApiClient {
  constructor(private readonly transport: ApiTransport, private readonly security: ClientSecurityOptions = {}) {}
  async call<K extends Exclude<OperationId, "streamBacktestEvents">>(operationId: K, input: OperationInputMap[K]): Promise<OperationOutputMap[K]> {
    return (await this.callWithResponse(operationId, input)).body;
  }
  async callWithResponse<K extends Exclude<OperationId, "streamBacktestEvents">>(operationId: K, input: OperationInputMap[K]): Promise<ApiCallResult<OperationOutputMap[K]>> {
    const operation = operations.get(operationId); if (!operation) throw new Error("UNKNOWN_OPERATION");
    await assertOperationInput(operationId, input);
    const path = encodePath(operation, input); const parts = requestParts(operationId, input);
    const response = await this.transport.request(path + parts.suffix, { method: operation.method, headers: parts.headers, ...(parts.body === undefined ? {} : { body: parts.body }) });
    if (response.status !== operation.successStatus) throw validatedApiResponseError(operation, response.status, response.body);
    await assertOperationSuccess(operationId, response.body, operation.responseType, this.security, input);
    if (operationId === "completeGoogleOAuthCallback") {
      const location = headerValue(response.headers, "Location"); const setCookie = headerValue(response.headers, "Set-Cookie");
      if (location === undefined || !SAFE_CALLBACK_LOCATION.test(location) || location.includes("\\") || setCookie === undefined || !SESSION_COOKIE.test(setCookie)) throw new Error("INVALID_OAUTH_CALLBACK_RESPONSE_HEADERS");
    }
    if (operationId === "createAnonymousSession") {
      const setCookie = headerValue(response.headers, "Set-Cookie");
      if (setCookie === undefined || !SESSION_COOKIE.test(setCookie)) throw new Error("INVALID_ANONYMOUS_SESSION_RESPONSE_HEADERS");
    }
    const etag = headerValue(response.headers, "ETag");
    if (operation.successEtagRequired && (etag === undefined || !STRONG_ETAG.test(etag))) throw new Error("MISSING_OR_INVALID_REQUIRED_ETAG");
    if (!operation.successEtagRequired && etag !== undefined) throw new Error("UNEXPECTED_ETAG");
    return { body: response.body as OperationOutputMap[K], headers: response.headers, ...(etag === undefined ? {} : { etag }) };
  }
  async *streamBacktestEvents(input: OperationInputMap["streamBacktestEvents"]): AsyncIterable<OperationOutputMap["streamBacktestEvents"] extends AsyncIterable<infer E> ? E : never> {
    const operation = operations.get("streamBacktestEvents"); if (!operation) throw new Error("UNKNOWN_OPERATION");
    const parts = requestParts("streamBacktestEvents", input); const path = encodePath(operation, input);
    let previous: BacktestEvent | undefined;
    const resumeFrom = input.request.lastEventId;
    if (resumeFrom !== undefined && !validRevision(resumeFrom)) throw new SseResyncRequiredError();
    const response = await this.transport.openEventStream(path, parts.headers);
    if (response.status !== operation.successStatus) throw validatedApiResponseError(operation, response.status, response.body);
    const contentType = headerValue(response.headers, "Content-Type")?.split(";", 1)[0]?.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (contentType !== "text/event-stream" || response.body !== undefined || response.stream === undefined || typeof response.stream[Symbol.asyncIterator] !== "function") throw new Error("INVALID_SSE_TRANSPORT_RESPONSE");
    for await (const frame of response.stream) {
      let event: BacktestEvent;
      try { event = await parseBacktestEventFrame(frame); } catch { throw new SseResyncRequiredError(); }
      if (event.backtestId !== input.id) throw new SseResyncRequiredError();
      if (previous === undefined && resumeFrom !== undefined && BigInt(event.sequence) !== BigInt(resumeFrom) + 1n) throw new SseResyncRequiredError();
      if (previous !== undefined) {
        if (event.sequence === previous.sequence) {
          if (canonicalJson(event) === canonicalJson(previous)) continue;
          throw new SseResyncRequiredError();
        }
        if (BigInt(event.sequence) !== BigInt(previous.sequence) + 1n || BigInt(event.jobRevision) !== BigInt(previous.jobRevision) + 1n || event.backtestId !== previous.backtestId || event.previousState !== previous.state || Date.parse(event.occurredAt) < Date.parse(previous.occurredAt) || !legalTransition(previous.state, event.state)) throw new SseResyncRequiredError();
      }
      previous = event;
      yield event;
    }
  }
}
